risk: Derived open repository changes upstream schema or endpoint
mitigation: Version raw inputs/schemas; source contracts; fall back CFBD/NCAA.

risk: CFBD API tier/terms/schema change
mitigation: Pin endpoint/schema evidence, cache raw, track tiers/terms, fallback bulk/official sources.

risk: Public availability report coverage is conference-game/date limited
mitigation: Explicit coverage mask; missingness is not available=healthy; school/media/licensed fallback.

risk: Nonconference and pre-report-era injury history incomplete
mitigation: Probabilistic missingness/degraded mode; do not fabricate injury states.

risk: Historical forecast archive differs by weather model/era
mitigation: Record model/run/version/lead; choose era-valid source and uncertainty.

risk: Observed weather leaks future conditions into earlier forecast
mitigation: Hard PIT weather control AC-013; observed data labels/verification only.

risk: Market snapshot history requires paid source or lacks older timestamps
mitigation: Pure-football lane independent; optional paid market enrichment; missing market lane explicit.

risk: Commercial vendor lock-in/cost escalation
mitigation: Optional adapters; no Phase1-4 core dependency without ADR/value evidence.

risk: Publicly accessible pages prohibit or constrain redistribution
mitigation: Source rights matrix/manual review; keep raw local; publish acquisition scripts/derived data only when defensible.

risk: Recruiting/transfer derived sources share same upstream publisher
mitigation: Track upstream lineage; do not count as independent corroboration.

risk: NCAA detailed Transfer Portal is restricted/non-public
mitigation: No bypass; use structured public/authorized alternatives and official aggregate research.

risk: Private-school resource proxies misread as football spending
mitigation: Keep proxy lane distinct; explicit semantic labels and missingness.

risk: Eligibility/roster/transfer regulations change feature meaning
mitigation: Effective-dated regulatory environment and rule-era versioning.

risk: Lower-division schemas/quality differ by governing body
mitigation: Normalize only required strength/translation signals with source confidence.

risk: No scalable public national historical depth-chart source
mitigation: A&M targeted official reconstruction; infer usage cautiously; commercial optional.

risk: No verified national pregame officiating assignment feed
mitigation: Experimental lane only; gamebooks for postgame history; suppress when unavailable.

risk: Advanced formation/coverage/tracking data is proprietary
mitigation: Phase-5 research-only; do not block core system.

risk: Conference/school pages may be edited after publication
mitigation: Snapshot HTML/PDF with retrieval + first-known/publication timestamps and hashes.

risk: Source IDs drift across providers/transfers/name changes
mitigation: W07 canonical mappings/aliases/temporal identity + unresolved review.

risk: Current source universe becomes stale
mitigation: W24 refresh plus targeted cadence/terms monitoring.
